# Johns Refair

> > Johns Refair provides professional HVAC services in Melbourne, specializing in split air conditioning, ducted heating, refrigeration repair, and energy-efficient climate control solutions.

Johns Refair serves the Melbourne area including Studfield with comprehensive heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services. The company focuses on split systems, ductless mini-splits, gas heating, and energy-efficient HVAC solutions with expertise in installation, maintenance, and repair.

## Key Topics

- Split air conditioning systems
- Ductless mini-split systems
- SEER (Seasonal Energy Efficiency Ratio)
- EER (Energy Efficiency Ratio)
- HVAC maintenance and repair
- Gas heating systems
- Energy efficiency optimization
- MERV filter ratings
- Smart thermostat integration
- Preventive HVAC maintenance
- Melbourne climate solutions
- BTU sizing and capacity
- AFUE heating efficiency
- Refrigerant management
